result.instructions: Tools for Loket.nl, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which employees of our company are currently on sick leave?"; "List the payroll administrations of my employer and their periods."; "Show the open workflows for leave requests this month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Loket.nl data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run loket_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run loket_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run loket_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. loket_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: loket_get_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Return the Loket user behind the access token: personal details, contact information and role. Loket API: GET /v2/user.

tools.name: loket_list_employers
tools.title: List employers
tools.description: List the employers this user can access (companies, with their ids). Start here to get an employer_id. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers.

filter.description: Loket filter expression, for example 'cancellationPeriodTimeUnit.key eq 4'.

order_by.description: Sort fields, for example '-companyName,address.houseNumber'. A leading '-' sorts descending.

tools.name: loket_get_employer
tools.title: Get employer
tools.description: Return one employer: company name, address, chamber of commerce number, legal form and settings. Loket API: GET /v2/providers/employers/{employerId}.

employer_id.description: Loket id (a GUID, as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: loket_list_payroll_administrations

employer_id.description: Loket id (a GUID, as returned by the list tools).

filter.description: Loket filter expression, for example 'cancellationPeriodTimeUnit.key eq 4'.

order_by.description: Sort fields, for example '-companyName,address.houseNumber'. A leading '-' sorts descending.
